force.title: Money Gets Unbundled
force.signature: Banking leaves the banks — it's embedded in apps, cards, and platforms — and scale, data, and the rails win while regional players and middlemen get squeezed.

A \u00b7 The core banks consolidate: Deposits, tech, and compliance costs push banking toward a few giants.
The rails that tax every swipe
Payment rails and card issuers take a cut of the whole economy's spending.
Capital markets and custody scale and financialize behind the scenes.
B \u00b7 Credit leaves the bank: Non-bank and embedded lenders route credit around the traditional bank.
Scoring and rating is its own toll-taking layer, now AI-driven.
C \u00b7 Advice & the retail saver: Passive funds and robo-advice compress fees; scale and trust win.
Brokerage, custody, and the float are quiet, scaled, rate-sensitive businesses.
D \u00b7 The tensions: Rate whiplash, a CRE loan wall, and tech costs pressure smaller banks toward mergers.
Living and dying by the rate
Fed rate moves reprice the whole lending stack — the swing factor for margins.
E \u00b7 The big picture: Capstone: finance splinters out of banks into rails, apps, and platforms; scale and data win, middlemen lose.
